notes.title: v.1.2.3463 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug introduced in the previous patch which made it impossible to get the final hidden achievement. Sorry!!
[*] Fixed a rare bug where the interface could get stuck in between modes and not take user input anymore.
[*] Got rid of duplicate event systems spawning into scenes (no actual impact on the user but would cause log files to fill with junk logs)

[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v.1.2.3333
notes.content:
What's new in v.1.2.3333?

I found and fixed even more obscure OpenDyslexic errors. Does anyone read these? Is anyone who plays this even dyslexic? I dedicated these hours of my life to you 😂

[list]
[*] OpenDyslexic is now disabled when Russian text is turned on, but if OpenDyslexic is left enabled and language is set back to English, it is also reenabled automatically. (This was to get around OpenDyslexic not containing Cyrillic glyphs.)
[*] Fixed bug where enabling OpenDyslexic, setting language to Russian, then setting language to English without ever leaving the settings menu would result in settings menu text not changing back to OpenDyslexic until the menu was closed and reopened.
[*] Fixed bug where the Quit/Save & Quit button would lose OpenDyslexic formatting when going from a savable scene to a non-savable one or vice-versa.
[*] Fixed awkward wrapping of "Save & Quit" text when OpenDyslexic enabled.
[*] Fixed prologue character card text getting misaligned when OpenDyslexic is on.
[*] Fixed "Loading..." never swapping to OpenDyslexic.
[*] Stopped intentionally glitchy text from swapping fonts to OpenDyslexic.
[*] Fixed version number losing OpenDyslexic formatting if the remote config data arrived after initialization.
[*] Changed all timers based on time since level load with time since mode change to get around timescale being set to zero on pause (this fixed various obscure UI bugs.)
[*] In the last patch I disabled shadowcasting on the light that shines in the last shot of Varya, but I changed my mind and reenabled it.
[*] Fixed a misaligned subtitle in the Act 3 Extra scene.
[*] Fixed an error with Varya's materials in Act 4.
[/list]

notes.title: v.1.2.3331 Update
notes.content:
What's new in v.1.2.3331?

[list]
[*] Pressing Escape on title menu no longer quits the game.
[*] It is now indicated in English that the sexy and awesome people listed in the credits are playtesters (this had always been indicated in Russian.)
[*] Fixed bug where if high contrast UI and OpenDyslexic were turned on at the same time, there was visible junk markup in every text object.
[*] When swapping to/from OpenDyslexic in the middle of an act, change now takes effect immediately rather than during the following line.
[*] Menu buttons now have consistent underlay styling when OpenDyslexic is on.
[*] Shadow distance and shadow projection is now dynamically set on a camera-shot basis in Act 4 to best balance performance vs. fancy graphics.
[*] Fixed several UI text objects which would never swap fonts to OpenDyslexic, including the version update prompt, playtesters card in credits, and some buttons.
[*] Updated OpenDyslexic font atlas to contain the proud and noble letter ñ
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/cbdfc2d780ced892e0aaf006adbaff2122d2c8f9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/da6118b57190652e79b39b3beb285bd75081e5b6.png[/img][/url]
[i]Mwah[/i]
[*] Loading to the middle of a scene from save now more reliable when returning to a line with split subtitle timing
[*] Fixed visual error where the edge of the in-world canvas at the start of act 1 was visible
[*] Fixed unstable shadow flashing in Act 4
[*] Split up several subtitles throughout the play
[*] Various small animation tweaks and fixes
[*] Fixed mistimed camera cut in the middle of act 3
[*] Fixed grass sometimes not appearing on title menu or appearing after a long delay
[*] Fixed error where if captions were turned on, the internal names of credits cards were visibly displayed.
[*] Fixed error where if "always show speaker's name" was on, Hermes' name would be indicated inline during a visual novel-styled segment in Act 3
[*] Fixed error where during a handful of lines in the middle of Act 3, if "always show speaker's name" was on, Hermes' name was indicated as "Ermolai". 
[/list]

notes.title: The Cherry Orchard v.1.2.3324
notes.content:

[list]
[*] 10 whole minutes of new content! Access it via Title > Scene Select > Act 3 Extra. It's just like the regular Act 3 but Varya and Trofimov have fake accents. I think that's the only difference. Yep.

[*] Fixed some stray textbox and subtitle errors.
[*] Rebalanced music volume in Act 3.
[*] Various animation tweaks across the board.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you hit skip precisely during the glitch sound effect in act 4, the SFX would keep playing into the next line.
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes if continuing into the middle of a scene from Title, certain characters would be deactivated.
[*] Some additional optimization.
[*] Save thumbnail is now also captured when quitting to title menu and when session ends unexpectedly within a story scene.
[*] Fixed some flickering related to volumetric light effect in Act 4.

By the way, if you have a support request, please tell me via [url=https://discord.gg/ZYQaH3G]Dogpit Discord[/url], I don't check the Steam forums much, and while my DMs are open on Twitter, Twitter keeps putting messages from non-mutuals into some other inbox and not notifying me? notes.title: The Cherry Orchard v.1.1.3300
notes.content:
Happy New Year! To celebrate here's a nice big update to The Cherry Orchard!  

What's new in v.1.1.3300?

[list]
[*] Over five minutes of static visual novel-styled passages have been replaced with cinematic passages containing totally new never-before-seen animation!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/d73774c742776145c4df06f503f160035ee40609.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/39b35756d5f4fdae405ff15e3a09bfcf5def44fe.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/89769285995db10ab8ef6acd80c4e516bb01fce8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/0c7ff33f30d569d69bdf336c30be7a2b73c0c7e9.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/17f0d2075a1047d4e10582270f183bfa780ed873.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/81f47f48fb9bb1449c980b794c625ee8c4ccad6b.png[/img][/url]
[*] Improvements to existing animation. Trofimov is now seen to wear boots at the end of Act 4! 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/1166cdf17ec443515619dd34b3cb3a077a0fa19f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38808072/f4aa258c63ef75d5317795f6a0839c12e33bfea4.png[/img][/url]
Wow!!
[*] Total overhaul of how line skip forward/backwards and continue from save works, increasing responsiveness and fixing a few edge case bugs.
[*] Fixed a bug where keyboard and gamepad input for skip forward/backward wouldn't work in Act 4.
[*] Added volumetric light ray effect to Act 4 and a few other places. 
[*] Added a neat horizontal bloom effect (seen mostly in Act 3).
[*] Some minor targeted headlook fixes and improvements
[*] Rebalanced music dynamics against voiceover.
[*] It's now possible to skip forwards/backwards in the credits by slide, in case you needed more time to read the Sexy and Awesome People list.
[*] A new hidden achievement! Happy hunting!
[/list]

notes.title: The Cherry Orchard Launch Day!
notes.content:
The Cherry Orchard has launched! 

This linear visual novel is based on the play of the same name by Anton Chekhov. Our version's script has been edited and abridged for clarity, but if you enjoy this adaptation, we encourage you to check out the full script of the play [url=https://www.gutenberg.org/files/7986/7986-h/7986-h.htm#link2H_4_0013]at Project Gutenberg[/url].

This project entered development in May of this year and was a labor of love by a group of people passionate about theater. Our goal was to put on a stage play despite being separated by disease and distance. Unusually for a video game, all voiceover was recorded in group sessions so that the actors could react to each other, and this authenticity to the moment elevates the performance to something truly special.

While not particularly well-known in general, The Cherry Orchard is highly regarded in the stage acting community and we hope that our production will show you exactly why it is considered one of the greatest plays of all time.

Questions or comments? Come say hi in the [url=https://discord.gg/ZYQaH3G]Dogpit Discord[/url]!
